newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bancomext says planning $300 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bancomext says planning $300 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Mexican development bank Bancomext said on Thursday it could launch a $300 million Eurobond in the coming two to three weeks.

"What we are planning is the possibility of launching a mid-term bond in these weeks...of about $300 million in the European markets," Bancomext director Enrique Vilatela told Reuters at a conference in this Caribbean resort.
Vilatela was attending a weeklong Caribbean business meeting.
He added that if conditions are favorable, "We could go to the markets before summer vacation and if not, then we will wait until after summer vacation."
Summer vacations in Mexico begin in July and end at the end of August.

Vilatela added that for the bank, the markets currently "appear very attractive." Bancomext could follow the recent success of the Mexican government's five-year sterling Eurobond, which offered an annual yield of 8.75 percent, or 173 basis points over five-year U.S. Treasuries.
